summary: First-finish smoke testing of AITAX Phase 1+2 MVP. Backend auth, dashboard KPIs, masters CRUD, sales create/delete with stock movement, tenant isolation, subscription plans, and Razorpay order creation all verified working. Frontend landing, login, dashboard with Indian INR formatting, customers, products, pricing all render correctly with proper data-testids.
passed: POST /api/auth/login with demo@aitax.in/Demo@12345 returns JWT + user object (200)
POST /api/auth/register creates new user, returns JWT, auto-creates company when business_name provided
GET /api/auth/me returns 401 without token, 200 with valid bearer token
GET /api/dashboard/kpis returns inventory_value=113900 (matches spec), customers=3, suppliers=2, products=5
GET /api/masters/parties?party_type=customer returns 3 seeded parties
POST /api/masters/parties creates customer, copies opening_balance=1000 to current_balance
GET /api/masters/products returns 5 seeded products with stock/price/gst
GET /api/masters/products/low-stock returns empty array (no low stock seeded)
POST /api/sales creates invoice INV-00001 with computed subtotal=500, gst_total=60 (12%), grand_total=560; status=sent; auto invoice_number prefix correct
Sales creation deducts product stock 30 -> 28
DELETE /api/sales/{id} returns {ok:true} and reverses stock 28 -> 30
GET /api/subscription/plans returns 3 plans (starter/pro/enterprise) with monthly/quarterly/yearly prices
POST /api/subscription/create-order returns order_id=order_T6nXAgaPvSH7KR, amount=49900, currency=INR, key_id=rzp_live_T6mxYH9aA8plbX (live Razorpay reachable)
POST /api/subscription/verify-payment with invalid signature correctly returns 400
Tenant isolation: newly registered user sees 0 parties (cannot see demo company data)
Frontend: Landing page renders with hero, nav, CTAs, plan price ₹499/mo
Frontend: Login form accepts demo creds, redirects to /app/dashboard, shows 'Welcome back, Demo Owner' toast

Frontend: Dashboard renders all 8 KPI cards with data-testids (kpi-sales-today, kpi-receipts, kpi-receivables, kpi-payables, kpi-inventory, kpi-profit, kpi-low-stock, kpi-counts); INVENTORY VALUE shows ₹1,13,900.00 in Indian numbering format
Frontend: Customers page (/app/customers) renders table with party-add button (data-testid present), shows ₹1,560.00 balance correctly
Frontend: Products page renders table with HSN, sale_price (₹250.00), GST 12%, stock 30 PCS
Frontend: Pricing page shows 3 plans with Monthly/Quarterly/Yearly tabs and Subscribe buttons
Frontend: Sidebar navigation exposes all routes (Dashboard, Customers, Suppliers, Products, Sales, Purchases, Inventory, Billing & Plans)

failed.issue: No element with data-testid='theme-toggle' or 'logout-button' found on dashboard. Theme toggle and Logout button could not be located via expected data-testid selectors.
failed.evidence: page.evaluate query returned count=0 for both [data-testid='theme-toggle'] and [data-testid='logout-button'] / button:has-text('Logout'|'Sign out')

Functionality may already exist (e.g., behind a user-menu dropdown) but is not discoverable via expected testids.
notes: Sales schema uses field names 'items', 'name', 'quantity' (not 'line_items'/'qty' as mentioned in review prompt). Backend behaviour is correct; the review-request wording was outdated. DELETE /api/sales/{id} works without trailing slash. Razorpay LIVE order created (no payment completed).
